11/**
12 * Service class for populating a table through a Spot Entity class.
13 */
14class EntityPopulator
15{
16    /**
17     * When fetching existing data - fetch only few first rows.
18     */
19    public const RELATED_FETCH_COUNT = 10;
20
21    /**
22     * @var Mapper
23     */
24    protected $mapper;
25
26    /**
27     * @var Locator
28     */
29    protected $locator;
30
31    /**
32     * @var array
33     */
34    protected $columnFormatters = [];
35    /**
36     * @var array
37     */
38    protected $modifiers = [];

41     * @var bool
42     */

45    /**
46     * @param bool $useExistingData
47     */
48    public function __construct(Mapper $mapper, Locator $locator, $useExistingData = false)
49    {
50        $this->mapper = $mapper;
51        $this->locator = $locator;
52        $this->useExistingData = $useExistingData;
53    }
54
55    /**
56     * @return string
57     */

99    /**
100     * @return array
101     */
102    public function guessColumnFormatters(Generator $generator)
103    {
104        $formatters = [];
105        $nameGuesser = new Name($generator);
106        $columnTypeGuesser = new ColumnTypeGuesser($generator);
107        $fields = $this->mapper->fields();
108
109        foreach ($fields as $fieldName => $field) {
110            if ($field['primary'] === true) {
111                continue;
112            }
113
114            if ($formatter = $nameGuesser->guessFormat($fieldName)) {
115                $formatters[$fieldName] = $formatter;
116
117                continue;
118            }
119
120            if ($formatter = $columnTypeGuesser->guessFormat($field)) {
121                $formatters[$fieldName] = $formatter;
122
123                continue;
124            }
125        }
126        $entityName = $this->mapper->entity();
127        $entity = $this->mapper->build([]);
128        $relations = $entityName::relations($this->mapper, $entity);
129
130        foreach ($relations as $relation) {
131            // We don't need any other relation here.
132            if ($relation instanceof BelongsTo) {
133                $fieldName = $relation->localKey();
134                $entityName = $relation->entityName();
135                $field = $fields[$fieldName];
136                $required = $field['required'];
137
138                $locator = $this->locator;
139
140                $formatters[$fieldName] = function ($inserted) use ($required, $entityName, $locator, $generator) {
141                    if (!empty($inserted[$entityName])) {
142                        return $generator->randomElement($inserted[$entityName])->get('id');
143                    }
144
145                    if ($required && $this->useExistingData) {
146                        // We did not add anything like this, but it's required,
147                        // So let's find something existing in DB.
148                        $mapper = $locator->mapper($entityName);
149                        $records = $mapper->all()->limit(self::RELATED_FETCH_COUNT)->toArray();
150
151                        if (empty($records)) {
152                            return null;
153                        }
154
155                        return $generator->randomElement($records)['id'];
156                    }
157
158                    return null;
159                };
160            }
161        }
162
163        return $formatters;
164    }
165
166    /**
167     * Insert one new record using the Entity class.
168     *
169     * @return string
170     */
171    public function execute($insertedEntities)
172    {
173        $obj = $this->mapper->build([]);
174
175        $this->fillColumns($obj, $insertedEntities);
176        $this->callMethods($obj, $insertedEntities);
177
178        $this->mapper->insert($obj);
179
180        return $obj;
181    }
182
183    private function fillColumns($obj, $insertedEntities): void
184    {
185        foreach ($this->columnFormatters as $field => $format) {
186            if (null !== $format) {
187                $value = is_callable($format) ? $format($insertedEntities, $obj) : $format;
188                $obj->set($field, $value);
189            }
190        }
191    }
192
193    private function callMethods($obj, $insertedEntities): void
194    {
195        foreach ($this->getModifiers() as $modifier) {
196            $modifier($obj, $insertedEntities);
197        }
198    }
199}
